task: Pick up the cup from the table and place it by the coaster.

intervals.start: The gripper has not yet grabbed the cup, and its tip is about 5 cm away from the cup.
intervals.end: The gripper closes and has just fully gripped the cup, slightly lifting it up.

intervals.start: The gripper is holding the cup and about 10 cm away from the coaster.
intervals.end: The gripper releases the cup so that it now rests by the coaster.

intervals.label: The gripper grabs the cup from the table.
The gripper places the cup by the coaster.
